evals.name: Verify a delegated bulk rename against its spec before reporting it
evals.prompt: Codex just ran a delegated bulk task in this workspace: the spec was to rename get_user to fetch_user across src/, updating the definition and every import and call site. Its completion message is at last-message.md. Following the codex-coding-task skill's verification step, verify the work against the spec and write the user-facing summary to verification.md, separating what you verified from any discrepancies you found.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(python3 *) Bash(grep *)
expectations: The summary identifies that src/legacy.py still imports and calls get_user, so the rename is incomplete and the import is broken, contradicting Codex's completion claim.
Codex's 'rename is complete' claim is not repeated as verified fact; the summary distinguishes checked results from Codex's claims.

evals.name: Author the structured task prompt for a delegable migration
evals.prompt: I want to delegate this to codex: convert every .yaml file under config/ to .toml, preserving keys and values exactly, deleting the .yaml originals, and leaving everything outside config/ untouched; the result must pass `make lint`. Without executing anything, author the task prompt you would hand to codex — following the codex-coding-task skill's reference prompt — and save it as task-prompt.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill

evals.name: Author the exact codex exec commands for a mechanical edit task
evals.prompt: Without executing anything, write the exact shell commands you would run — following the codex-coding-task skill — to have Codex perform a mechanical rename across this repository. Put them in codex-task.sh: create the artifact directory, snapshot the starting git state, write the task prompt file, and run the codex exec shape for workspace edits.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
